gold_note: Single MPT drawn against a stage timescale, Bremer and bootstrap values, 27 tips. Two places are drawn with crossing lines rather than a joining vertical: the ankylosaurs (read as ((Gastonia,Sauropelta),(Euoplocephalus,Paranthodon))) and the Baiyinosaurus clade (read as (Isaberrysaura,(Baiyinosaurus,Gigantspinosaurus)), which matches the text). Exclude those two splits if the reading is in doubt. Matrix spellings: D._armatus (printed Dacentrurus), S._stenops, S._homheni.
